name: [UPDATE 1] I Can Read Your Mind
desc:
🔮 I CAN READ YOUR MIND 🔮
🆕 UPDATE 1: THE MIND SHOP IS OPEN!

Think of ANYTHING. A YouTuber, an anime character, a Roblox game. Answer my questions and I'll tell you exactly what you're thinking of.

✨ NEW IN UPDATE 1
🪙 Earn TOKENS every round: +10 when I read your mind, +25 when you stump me
🛍️ Spend them in the brand-new SHOP: genie skins, add-ons, magic auras and themes
🎃 LIMITED Halloween bundle: the Pumpkin King Genie + Haunted Night
🧠 SMARTER AI: our most advanced mind-reading brain yet. It learns from how real players answer

🧠 100,000+ things in my head, from viral memes to ancient philosophers
⚡ PLAY AGAIN has 0 wait: I tell you instantly
🔁 Come back tomorrow: I'll know even more than today

👀 COMING SOON: REVERSE MODE. This time YOU read MY mind.

Think you can beat me? Pick something weird. 👀
👍 LIKE the game if I read your mind!

llm.loop: think of anything -> answer yes/no questions -> the genie guesses -> stump it and teach it the answer -> play again instantly
llm.objectives: see if it can read your mind, or stump it
llm.instructions: think of anything, answer questions; like if it read your mind
unique: Akinator-style guesser that learns from players
update_signals: claims to know more each day
llm.thumbnails: genie pointing at a Roblox logo ('YOU'RE THINKING OF... ROBLOX!'), yes/no buttons
llm.complexity_notes: question tree and answer database are the real work
